images.alt: FSP's new PSU design manages to compete with other high-end platforms in this category. The HG650 offers good overall performance and thanks to its HDB fan and Japanese electrolytic capacitors its reliability should be excellent as well.
Looking at the Hydro G 650W, we again see a unit that had excellent voltage regulation, very good efficiency, excellent DC Output Quality, and very good/excellent build quality.

Hydro G 650W is one of the most affordable 600- to 700-watt, 80 PLUS Gold-certified power supplies. FSP Group doesn’t skimp on the PSU’s quality, either. Enthusiasts benefit from the convenience of fully modular cables, near-silent operation, and FSP Group’s server-grade design.
